why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Catalyst airdrop page Go to the Krain airdrop page and check that the Catalyst Airdrop Season is shown as open.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Connect your wallet in the Krain app so your progress and streaks are tracked.
3 Step 3 : Complete the repeatable quests Write reviews, vote on apps, try apps, view apps and submit quality AI apps, staying within each action's daily limit.
4 Step 4 : Claim the daily check-in After finishing the day's quests, claim the check-in bonus of 500 XP.
5 Step 5 : Keep your streak going Check in on consecutive days to raise the check-in bonus up to 2x, and use Saturdays and Sundays (UTC) when a 1.5x multiplier applies to select actions.
